name: observed-raw-region-context-v1
coordinates: the two original ordinal input token IDs within each frozen source block
construction: checked integer convex hulls of observed points for each raw class
overlap: any intersection of different-class hulls refuses the entire block
coverage: unique same-label convex combination with at most three observed states
certificate: exact rational nonnegative masses, unit total and input-coordinate identity
eligibility: matched unseen input in an ambiguous block with disjoint class hulls
fallback: exact complete CM46 parent on observed, unsupported, refused or uncovered inputs
head: all unchanged actual complex coefficients; mix source features before the complete product
modes: retain original full/minibatch/forward training and all original records and tails
scope: geometry identifies labels only under convex raw-class realizability; flatness supplies bounds
